findings.impact: Seven inherited bytes_from_stat fields would remain inconsistent with current hash-bound source identities. For example, full-cohort-controller.spec.ts would pair the current97a9936c hash with55764 bytes instead of74348. This is an inventory metadata defect, not source drift.
